client.business_model: Multi-state provider of home health, hospice and rehabilitation services operating dozens of branch locations across the southern and western United States.
client.client_history: Founded in 2007 by licensed physical therapist David Jackson, Choice Health At Home has grown through a series of add-on acquisitions to become a regional leader in post-acute home health and hospice. Private-equity investments from Trive Capital (2020) and Coltala Holdings (2021) have accelerated its expansion across Texas, Oklahoma and several neighboring states.

revenue.notes: No explicit revenue figures located in provided documents, company website, or cited web sources.

locations.source: Company website locations page (choicehealthathome.com/locations) – counted individual city listings provided in web search result.
locations.notes: Manually counted 47 distinct city locations across AZ, CO, KS, NV, OK, TX and UT as listed on the official locations page.

employees.source: LinkedIn company page for Choice Health At Home (accessed 2024) which reports a range of 1,001–5,000 employees.
employees.notes: LinkedIn only provides a range; lower bound (≈1,000) recorded to give an integer estimate. No additional corroborating sources found.
